name: TC-738: host list loads for every staff member, but only hosts get guest phone/email; a non-host can't hold a table
description: GET /api/tablet/host (2026-10-06, option A): a STAFF member with HOST_MANAGE_RESERVATIONS revoked still gets 200 and the day's rows, with `canManage: false` and NO guestPhone/guestEmail keys.
